leagueHeadline: Only one A in the room.
leagueDek: Chen's 0.5 PPR board re-grades Full Contact after 180 picks. Yahoo's letters are noise. Maye Bijan Cook is the room's A.

teams.headline: The RB factory that waited on Caleb
teams.story: Maye Bijan Cook gets the only A in the room, and it is not close. Christian McCaffrey at seven and Omarion Hampton at eighteen gave them the best backfield on the board, then they just kept stacking: Love, Corum, even a flyer on Kaelon Black. The receivers are real too — Garrett Wilson, Jameson Williams, Rome Odunze — and Tucker Kraft is a fine TE1. Caleb Williams in the tenth is the punchline: Chen 66 at pick 114. Emmett Johnson in the twelfth is the one reach nobody will remember if CMC stays upright. First of twelve. Average Chen rank 64.8.

teams.headline: Cook, Achane, Nabers — then they kept stacking
teams.story: Amon Drugs took James Cook and De'Von Achane back-to-back, then Malik Nabers fell into the third. That is an A- core. Tee Higgins and Tyler Warren made the middle rounds look professional, Mike Evans is still Mike Evans, and Dak Prescott in the eighth is a perfectly boring QB1. Michael Pittman Jr. at 113 is the steal the grader likes; Matthew Golden at 104 is the one early swing. Josh Jacobs and Brian Robinson on the bench mean this team does not die in November. Second of twelve, and the only roster that can argue with the winner.

teams.headline: JSN and Nico, then Mahomes in the parking lot
teams.story: Cobra Kai opened Jaxon Smith-Njigba and Nico Collins and never really left the receiver aisle: Metcalf, Sutton, Diggs, then Jordyn Tyson a round too soon. That is a B+ because the ceiling is loud and the running backs are merely fine — Swift and Price as the starters, White and Spears behind them. Jayden Daniels in the sixth is the plan; Patrick Mahomes at 174 is the backup plan Chen still ranks 104. Colston Loveland as the TE1 is a swing. Third of twelve, every starter filled, and the late Mahomes pick is the one the group chat will screenshot.

teams.headline: Bijan, Bowers, and a WR room that never sat down
teams.story: Blowing Lines of $crimmage built the most top-heavy roster in the draft and still only gets a B, because the late rounds got cute. Bijan Robinson, George Pickens, and Brock Bowers in the first three is a loaded core — three players inside Chen's top 24. Rashee Rice and Jalen Hurts made the next two loops look easy. Then came seven wide receivers and a twelfth-round Pat Bryant that Chen has at 178. Denzel Boston at 170 is a fine dart. The talent is real. The bench is a yard sale. Fourth of twelve.

teams.headline: Taylor, A.J. Brown, and Lamar before the turn
teams.story: Strange Walker on the Fields drafted like they had a plan: Jonathan Taylor, A.J. Brown, Javonte Williams, then Lamar Jackson in the fourth. That is a B with two top-24 anchors and a quarterback you actually want. Terry McLaurin and Marvin Harrison Jr. keep the WR room honest; Chris Godwin is the injury bet. Trevor Lawrence at 101 is the steal the math likes. Jalen Coker at 116 is the reach nobody needed. Brenton Strange as TE1 is a name-brand joke that also happens to be thin. Fifth of twelve, complete lineup, no excuses in week one.

teams.headline: Two early backs, then they reached for a prayer
teams.story: Touchdown Palace went Kenneth Walker and Chase Brown in the first two rounds and suddenly had the second-best rushing start in the league. Zay Flowers and Ladd McConkey made the next loop look like a WR committee you can live with. Christian Watson and Parker Washington kept stacking. Then the draft got spicy: Jaxson Dart, Isaiah Likely, and a thirteenth-round Chris Bell that Chen has at 199 — fifty-three picks too early. Bo Nix at 134 is the actual steal. B- is the grade for a good start that spent its last chips on hope. Sixth of twelve.

teams.headline: Three studs, then they fell in love with tight ends
teams.story: Smoke 'em if you got 'em started Saquon, Jefferson, and Drake London. That is a loaded core and a C+ anyway, because the rest of the night was a tight-end convention. Dalton Kincaid at 63 is a 47-pick reach on Chen's board. Then they added Juwan Johnson, Dallas Goedert, and Mark Andrews. Four TEs. Drake Maye in the fourth is fine. Rhamondre and Dowdle are the RB2 committee. The top three can win weeks. The middle of this roster is a committee meeting. Seventh of twelve, and the Kincaid pick is the one that knocked them out of B range.

teams.headline: Sun God and King Henry, then Keenan in the tenth
teams.story: Hailee's New Muse took Amon-Ra, Derrick Henry, and Chris Olave and had three top-24 players before the snack break. Joe Burrow in the sixth is a steal at 64. Then the board punished them. Keenan Allen at 112 is a seventy-pick reach — Chen has him at 174 — and Travis Hunter in the fifteenth is a novelty, not a plan. Luther Burden and Harold Fannin are the interesting middle. Cam Skattebo and Chuba Hubbard are the RB committee behind Henry. C is the grade for a gorgeous start that spent the second half collecting names. Eighth of twelve.

teams.headline: Chase at three, then the board got weird
teams.story: Biscokid opened Ja'Marr Chase and then watched the easy part of the draft end. Breece Hall in the second is a fine RB1 if you squint at the Jets. Trey McBride in the third is the best TE they could have hoped for. After that it is Montgomery, Warren, Lloyd, and Aaron Jones a round too soon. Justin Herbert in the seventh is the QB1; Jared Goff at 147 is the Chen-approved backup. One top-24 player. Four names inside the top 60. C is the honest letter: Chase can carry weeks, the supporting cast has to stay healthy. Ninth of twelve.

teams.headline: CeeDee and Josh Allen, then a lot of hope
teams.story: The Allen Parsons Project took CeeDee Lamb and Josh Allen and then spent the rest of the night trying to invent a running game. Travis Etienne in the third is the RB1. Tony Pollard is the RB2. Mike Washington Jr. at 109 is a thirty-two-pick reach. Davante Adams at 60 is the one clean value. Jaylen Waddle, Kyle Pitts, Michael Wilson, and a pile of late receivers mean this team can look pretty on Sunday and still lose the week. C- is a star-and-scrubs grade. Tenth of twelve, one elite anchor, and a bench that needs injuries elsewhere.

teams.headline: Gibbs at 1.01, and then the cliff
teams.story: Sutton My Face took Jahmyr Gibbs first overall and then drafted like the hard part was over. Kyren Williams and DeVonta Smith are fine. DJ Moore, Judkins, and Carnell Tate are a committee, not a punch. George Kittle in the eighth is a TE you can start. Dalton Schultz at 120 is a thirty-nine-pick reach. Matthew Stafford in the twelfth is the steal the grader found because someone had to be the steal. One top-24 player, then a long slide. D+ is the letter for winning the auction and losing the rest of the night. Eleventh of twelve. Average Chen rank 85.5.

teams.headline: Puka and Jeanty, then Tank Bigsby ended the party
teams.story: Puka in the LaPorta Potty started Puka Nacua and Ashton Jeanty and had two top-24 pieces. Bucky Irving, Tetairoa McMillan, and Emeka Egbuka made the next three rounds look competitive. Sam LaPorta in the sixth is the name on the jersey. Then Tank Bigsby at 100 — Chen 144, fifty picks too early — and the room slid to last. Travis Kelce at 117 is a consolation steal. Sam Darnold as the QB1 in the thirteenth is a choice. D is the grade for a pretty top that spent its late capital on a running back Chen had in the parking lot. Twelfth of twelve.
